title: The Full AfterLife — Your Complete Move to Spain
meta: End-to-end concierge for North Americans relocating to Spain: visa, property and settling handled together, from first call to keys.
h1: From the decision to the keys.
lead: The whole move — residency, property, banking, settlement — handled as one engagement, by one team, from the day you decide to the first morning you wake up here.

cta.heading: Find out if Spain is right for you.
cta.note: No charge. No obligation. No pitch.
cta.lead: A free 45-minute call. We cover your visa eligibility, what your equity buys here, the property that fits, and a realistic timeline. No pitch — if Spain isn't the right move for you, you'll hear that too.

blocks.label: What this is
blocks.heading: One relationship. Start to finish.
paras: Most people moving to Spain end up assembling a committee: a gestor, an immigration lawyer, a real estate agent who works for the seller, a property lawyer, a bank, and a translator. Six relationships, none of whom talk to each other, in a language you are still learning, across a timeline nobody owns.

The Full AfterLife is the alternative. We hold the whole thing. Your residency and your property run as one coordinated engagement — same team, same timeline, one point of contact who already knows your file when you call. The legal work is done by vetted partner firms, but you never get handed off. You deal with us, throughout.
It is the way we would have wanted it done. So it is the way we built it.

blocks.label: How the money works
blocks.heading: No surprises. We disclose all of it.

paras: Why we tell you this. The commission that funds your representation is real, and we would rather you hear it from us than wonder about it later. An agent paid by the seller has a quiet incentive to close. An agent paid the same regardless of which property you choose does not. We have arranged it the second way on purpose — and we are happy to walk you through every euro of it on the call.

money: A fixed fee, agreed before we start. No hourly billing, no creep.
The legal partner fee (€1,500 per applicant) is inside that price, not on top of it.
Certified translations passed through at cost — exactly what the translator charges, zero markup.
Buyer's representation is funded by the standard commission paid on the seller's side — typically 2–3% of the price.
It costs you nothing beyond the purchase itself and your own conveyancing lawyer.
Your property lawyer and the notary are paid directly by you, at their own published rates.

blocks.label: The sequence
blocks.heading: What actually happens, in order.
steps: Eligibility, finances, property goals, timeline. Free, and honest — if Spain isn't right for you, we say so.
Document brief, pre-submission review, and the formal NLV application managed through our legal partner.
Your foreigner's tax number and a working CaixaBank account — the two keys everything else turns on.
We brief the market to your criteria, shortlist, and view with you — fincas, coast, city, or all three.
We negotiate and your lawyer drafts the arras contract. Title and charges checked before a euro moves.
The public deed is signed before a notary, ITP is coordinated, and the property is yours.
Empadronamiento, utilities, residency card, the practical first weeks — and a few introductions.
You wake up here, and realise you got the timing exactly right.

blocks.label: A note on tax
blocks.heading: Beckham Law has a window.
paras: Spain's special expatriate regime — a flat 24% on Spanish-source income up to a generous ceiling — can be elected only inside a six-month window after you register with Spanish social security. Miss it and it is gone; there is no second application. For a Full AfterLife engagement, the question of whether it fits your situation is on the table from the first call, not discovered at month four when the door is already closing.
It is available as a €2,500-per-person add-on, and it is included outright in the Private Client engagement.

blocks.label: Why we built this
blocks.heading: Find out if Spain is right for you.
paras: Our founder made the move personally — from Mexico to Spain, through the tourist-visa years, the Digital Nomad Visa, and Spanish residency — before building Spanish AfterLife. The seams in this process are not theoretical to us. We know where a move like this gets handed off, dropped, or lost in translation, because we have lived in the bureaucracy ourselves. The visa and tax work we run for you is handled with vetted legal partners. The Full AfterLife exists to close the gaps.
